title: Arbor: How Search Policy Shapes Agent Behavior in System Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2606.12563v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Achieving peak performance on modern accelerators requires coordinated optimization across kernels, operator fusion, KV-cache management, quantization, scheduling, and communication overlap, a process that demands weeks of expert effort per model and hardware platform. We present Arbor, a system that gives autonomous agents an explicit optimization tree to reason over, backtrack through, and deepen with experience, with pluggable search policies, scored bandit traversal, parallel agent swarms, and depth-first sweep, sharing a common harness of containerized isolation, automatic rollback, and end-to-end validation. Arbor generalizes across domains: +40% to +193% on six production inference models across two GPU generations, +42.8% on LLM training, and +41% on recommendation training, where agents autonomously wrote kernel-level and framework-level optimizations spanning thousands of lines of code. translated_title: Arbor：搜索策略如何塑造系统优化中的智能体行为
translated_abstract: 在现代加速器上实现峰值性能需要在内核、算子融合、KV缓存管理、量化、调度和通信重叠等方面进行协同优化，这一过程对每个模型和硬件平台都需要数周的专家投入。我们提出了Arbor，一个为自主智能体提供显式优化树的系统，使其能够进行推理、回溯，并通过经验不断深化探索。该系统具备可插拔的搜索策略、评分式多臂老虎机遍历、并行智能体集群和深度优先扫描，并共享一个由容器化隔离、自动回滚和端到端验证组成的通用框架。Arbor具备跨领域泛化能力：在两代GPU上的六个生产级推理模型上提升40%至193%，在LLM训练上提升42.8%，在推荐训练上提升41%，其中智能体自主编写了跨越数千行代码的内核级和框架级优化。在受控消融实验中，每个搜索……
tldr: Arbor通过为自主智能体提供显式优化树和可插拔搜索策略，在推理、LLM训练和推荐系统等多个领域实现了40%至193%的性能提升，并证明搜索策略是塑造智能体优化行为的关键因素。
en_tdlr: Arbor provides autonomous agents with an explicit optimization tree and pluggable search policies, achieving 40-193% speedups across inference, LLM training, and recommendation workloads, demonstrating that search policy fundamentally shapes agent optimization behavior.
